items.why: Build and lint both looked at Nanoha's on-stage sprite in her own interlude but only at its expression; none said the POV character shouldn't be on stage (build's face-window pass called the interlude fine).
Build's face-window pass explicitly cleared Ōno as a NOWIN speaker; the only Ōno findings (diagnosis on 210's 'I', reader1's 'Settle down' flat line) are about wording, not his missing sprite.

by.quote: The cut out of Natsuki's intro CG flashes an empty classroom, then she ghosts in ... This is the hitch moment the chapter is built around (scene 1.4). ... Fix: in `ch01.ozs`, move `@show natsuki school_grin c` above `@cg - cut`.
Problem N2 (minor, matches the text): the CG holds a wave while the text says she counts. ... The alternative is to move `@cg - cut` up to just before line 220, but that cuts the CG to two lines.
A small tense slip at the reveal (staging) Line 226: "Her eyes go along the rows while she says it." She has already finished her introduction (lines 218–223), and the CG has just been cleared.

items.why: Three checks touched the CG-to-sprite handoff around the hitch (a transition glitch, a text/CG sync, a tense slip), but none said the hitch should play on the CG until she walks to his seat; onmodel's alternative would shorten the CG.

by.quote: The "super tall" setup never pays off. Rika spent a whole beat on "super tall, taller than the vice-principal," ... Either pay it off in a line ("She has to duck her head a little under the door rail" or similar) or cut Rika's line.

The class rumour was that she's "super tall. Taller than the vice-principal!" Nothing in the picture tells me she's tall; she looks average height ... If her height matters later, the one illustration of her doesn't sell it.
Height: Rika built up "super tall, taller than the vice-principal", but the art gives no sense of her height ... She reads as an average-height girl. A missed payoff more than an error.
191 "The vice-principal is five feet tall. In shoes." FLAT, off-voice. "In shoes." is Nanoha's deadpan tag. Ryōsuke would give the figure and where it comes from.

items.why: Reader3 points at Rika's line and offers the author's fix (cut it); readers 1 and 2 flag the same unbacked height but blame the art; diagnosis flags only Ryōsuke's reply for voice; continuity explicitly cleared the rumor at 5′3″.
Onmodel and all three readers compared the cut with the CG and called it a match (back of the wrist); no check raised the wrist side.
